steps.title: Bem-vindo: Daily Life - Volume 3
steps.text: In this A1-level lesson, we'll explore essential vocabulary and phrases about "Daily Life". Get ready to level up your real-world communication skills!

words.example: Can you take out the trash tonight?
My daily commute takes about an hour.
We waited in line for twenty minutes.

steps.title: Idiom: Under the weather
steps.text: It means: "Feeling slightly ill.". Say the example sentence out loud:
steps.targetPhrase: I'm feeling a bit under the weather today.
